facts.text: Under Drury University's Fusion curriculum, each student is guaranteed at least three academic credentials, with at least one in the “Life” category and one in the “Profession” category.

sources.title: Drury Fusion Curriculum | Certificate | Major | Minor
sources.quote: Each Drury student is guaranteed at least three credentials (credentials being majors, minors, and certificates). Of the three credentials, at least one must be in the “Life” category and one must be in the “Profession” category.
